title: प्रथमोऽध्यायः
titleEn: Adhyaya 1 · Choosing a place to hide

summary.en: Janamejaya asks how the Pandavas spent the year of hiding in Virata's city. Arjuna lists kingdoms where they might live, and Yudhishthira chooses the land of the Matsyas under the old and generous King Virata, and announces that he will serve the king as a Brahmin dicer named Kanka.
summary.kn: ವಿರಾಟನಗರದಲ್ಲಿ ಪಾಂಡವರು ಅಜ್ಞಾತವಾಸವನ್ನು ಹೇಗೆ ಕಳೆದರೆಂದು ಜನಮೇಜಯನು ಕೇಳುತ್ತಾನೆ. ವಾಸಿಸಬಹುದಾದ ರಾಜ್ಯಗಳನ್ನು ಅರ್ಜುನನು ಪಟ್ಟಿಮಾಡುತ್ತಾನೆ; ಯುಧಿಷ್ಠಿರನು ವೃದ್ಧ, ಉದಾರ ವಿರಾಟರಾಜನ ಮತ್ಸ್ಯದೇಶವನ್ನು ಆರಿಸಿ, ತಾನು ಕಂಕನೆಂಬ ಬ್ರಾಹ್ಮಣ ದ್ಯೂತಪಟುವಾಗಿ ರಾಜನ ಸೇವೆ ಮಾಡುವೆನೆನ್ನುತ್ತಾನೆ.
summary.hi: जनमेजय पूछते हैं कि पाण्डवों ने विराट नगर में अज्ञातवास कैसे बिताया। अर्जुन रहने योग्य राज्यों के नाम गिनाते हैं, और युधिष्ठिर वृद्ध तथा उदार राजा विराट के मत्स्य देश को चुनते हैं और कहते हैं कि वे कङ्क नाम के ब्राह्मण द्यूतकार बनकर राजा की सेवा करेंगे।
summary.te: విరాటనగరంలో పాండవులు అజ్ఞాతవాసాన్ని ఎలా గడిపారని జనమేజయుడు అడుగుతాడు. నివసించదగిన రాజ్యాలను అర్జునుడు పేర్కొంటాడు; యుధిష్ఠిరుడు వృద్ధుడు, ఉదారుడైన విరాటరాజు మత్స్యదేశాన్ని ఎంచుకొని, తాను కంకుడనే బ్రాహ్మణ ద్యూతకారునిగా రాజుకు సేవ చేస్తానంటాడు.
summary.ta: விராட நகரில் பாண்டவர்கள் மறைவு வாழ்வை எப்படிக் கழித்தார்கள் என்று ஜனமேஜயன் கேட்கிறான். வாழத் தகுந்த நாடுகளை அர்ஜுனன் பட்டியலிட, யுதிஷ்டிரர் முதிய, தாராள விராட மன்னனின் மத்ஸ்ய நாட்டைத் தேர்ந்து, தாம் கங்கன் என்ற அந்தணச் சூதாடியாக மன்னனுக்குப் பணிபுரிவதாகச் சொல்கிறார்.
summary.ml: വിരാടന്റെ നഗരത്തിൽ പാണ്ഡവർ ഒളിവിൽ കഴിയേണ്ട ഇടം ജനമേജയൻ ചോദിക്കുന്നു. പാർക്കാവുന്ന രാജ്യങ്ങൾ അർജുനൻ പറയുന്നു; വൃദ്ധനും ഉദാരനുമായ വിരാടരാജാവിന്റെ മത്സ്യദേശം യുധിഷ്ഠിരൻ തിരഞ്ഞെടുക്കുന്നു. കങ്കൻ എന്ന ബ്രാഹ്മണ ചൂതുകളിക്കാരനായി രാജസേവ ചെയ്യുമെന്ന് അദ്ദേഹം പ്രഖ്യാപിക്കുന്നു.

source: Mahabharata, Critical Edition (BORI, Pune) 4.1; e-text by M. Tokunaga and J. D. Smith, © BORI 1999, version of Thu Dec  1 2011

verses.text: जनमेजय उवाच

meaning.en: Janamejaya said:

verses.text:
कथं विराटनगरे मम पूर्वपितामहाः ।
अज्ञातवासमुषिता दुर्योधनभयार्दिताः ॥

meaning.en: How did my forefathers, the Pandavas, spend their year of hidden life in Virata's city, tormented as they were by fear of Duryodhana?

verses.text: वैशंपायन उवाच

meaning.en: Vaishampayana said:

verses.text:
तथा तु स वराँल्लब्ध्वा धर्माद्धर्मभृतां वरः ।
गत्वाश्रमं ब्राह्मणेभ्य आचख्यौ सर्वमेव तत् ॥

meaning.en: Having won those boons from Dharma, the best of the righteous went to the hermitage and told the brahmins all that had happened.

verses.text:
कथयित्वा तु तत्सर्वं ब्राह्मणेभ्यो युधिष्ठिरः ।
अरणीसहितं तस्मै ब्राह्मणाय न्यवेदयत् ॥

meaning.en: When Yudhishthira had told the brahmins everything, he returned the fire-sticks to the brahmin who had lost them.

verses.text:
ततो युधिष्ठिरो राजा धर्मपुत्रो महामनाः ।
संनिवर्त्यानुजान्सर्वानिति होवाच भारत ॥

meaning.en: Then King Yudhishthira, the noble son of Dharma, called back all his brothers and spoke to them, O Bharata:

verses.text:
द्वादशेमानि वर्षाणि राष्ट्राद्विप्रोषिता वयम् ।
त्रयोदशोऽयं संप्राप्तः कृच्छ्रः परमदुर्वसः ॥

meaning.en: We have spent twelve years banished from our kingdom, and now the thirteenth, hard and most difficult to live through, has arrived.

verses.text:
स साधु कौन्तेय इतो वासमर्जुन रोचय ।
यत्रेमा वसतीः सर्वा वसेमाविदिताः परैः ॥

meaning.en: So, Arjuna, son of Kunti, choose a good place from here where we can live this whole year unrecognized by our enemies.

verses.text: अर्जुन उवाच

meaning.en: Arjuna said:

verses.text:
तस्यैव वरदानेन धर्मस्य मनुजाधिप ।
अज्ञाता विचरिष्यामो नराणां भरतर्षभ ॥

meaning.en: By the very boon granted by Dharma, O lord of men, we shall move about unrecognized by people, O bull of the Bharatas.

verses.text:
किं तु वासाय राष्ट्राणि कीर्तयिष्यामि कानिचित् ।
रमणीयानि गुप्तानि तेषां किंचित्स्म रोचय ॥

meaning.en: Still, I shall name a few lovely and secluded kingdoms for our stay; please choose one of them.

verses.text:
सन्ति रम्या जनपदा बह्वन्नाः परितः कुरून् ।
पाञ्चालाश्चेदिमत्स्याश्च शूरसेनाः पटच्चराः ।
दशार्णा नवराष्ट्रं च मल्लाः शाल्वा युगंधराः ॥

meaning.en: Around the Kurus lie pleasant lands rich in grain: the Panchalas, Chedis, Matsyas, Shurasenas, Patachcharas, Dasharnas, Navarashtra, Mallas, Shalvas and Yugandharas.

verses.text:
एतेषां कतमो राजन्निवासस्तव रोचते ।
वत्स्यामो यत्र राजेन्द्र संवत्सरमिमं वयम् ॥

meaning.en: O king, which of these do you like as our residence? Tell us where we shall live this year, O best of kings.

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
एवमेतन्महाबाहो यथा स भगवान्प्रभुः ।
अब्रवीत्सर्वभूतेशस्तत्तथा न तदन्यथा ॥

meaning.en: It is just as you say, mighty-armed Arjuna; whatever the Lord, master of all beings, declared will be so and not otherwise.

verses.text:
अवश्यं त्वेव वासार्थं रमणीयं शिवं सुखम् ।
संमन्त्र्य सहितैः सर्वैर्द्रष्टव्यमकुतोभयम् ॥

meaning.en: Yet we must choose a place to live that is pleasant, safe and comfortable, and after consulting all together we must find one free from any fear.

verses.text:
मत्स्यो विराटो बलवानभिरक्षेत्स पाण्डवान् ।
धर्मशीलो वदान्यश्च वृद्धश्च सुमहाधनः ॥

meaning.en: The Matsya king Virata is powerful, and he could protect the Pandavas; he is righteous, generous, aged and very rich.

verses.text:
विराटनगरे तात संवत्सरमिमं वयम् ।
कुर्वन्तस्तस्य कर्माणि विहरिष्याम भारत ॥

meaning.en: Dear brother, we shall spend this year in Virata's city, serving him and enjoying ourselves, O Bharata.

verses.text:
यानि यानि च कर्माणि तस्य शक्ष्यामहे वयम् ।
कर्तुं यो यत्स तत्कर्म ब्रवीतु कुरुनन्दनाः ॥

meaning.en: Let each of you, sons of the Kurus, say what work he will be able to do for that king.

verses.text: अर्जुन उवाच

meaning.en: Arjuna said:

verses.text:
नरदेव कथं कर्म राष्ट्रे तस्य करिष्यसि ।
विराटनृपतेः साधो रंस्यसे केन कर्मणा ॥

meaning.en: O king, what work will you do in his kingdom? What duty will you find pleasing under the good King Virata?

verses.text:
मृदुर्वदान्यो ह्रीमांश्च धार्मिकः सत्यविक्रमः ।
राजंस्त्वमापदा क्लिष्टः किं करिष्यसि पाण्डव ॥

meaning.en: You are gentle, generous, modest, righteous and truly valiant. Being afflicted by misfortune, what will you do, Pandava?

verses.text:
न दुःखमुचितं किंचिद्राजन्वेद यथा जनः ।
स इमामापदं प्राप्य कथं घोरां तरिष्यसि ॥

meaning.en: O king, you have never known any hardship as ordinary people know it; having fallen into this dreadful calamity, how will you get across it?

verses.text: युधिष्ठिर उवाच

meaning.en: Yudhishthira said:

verses.text:
शृणुध्वं यत्करिष्यामि कर्म वै कुरुनन्दनाः ।
विराटमनुसंप्राप्य राजानं पुरुषर्षभम् ॥

meaning.en: Hear, sons of the Kurus, what work I shall do when I reach King Virata, that best of men.

verses.text:
सभास्तारो भविष्यामि तस्य राज्ञो महात्मनः ।
कङ्को नाम द्विजो भूत्वा मताक्षः प्रियदेविता ॥

meaning.en: I shall become a courtier in that great king's assembly, a brahmin named Kanka, skilled at dice and fond of gambling.

verses.text:
वैडूर्यान्काञ्चनान्दान्तान्फलैर्ज्योतीरसैः सह ।
कृष्णाक्षाँल्लोहिताक्षांश्च निर्वर्त्स्यामि मनोरमान् ॥

meaning.en: I shall make pleasing dice out of beryl, gold and ivory, with colored pips, and cast them with black and red markings.

verses.text:
आसं युधिष्ठिरस्याहं पुरा प्राणसमः सखा ।
इति वक्ष्यामि राजानं यदि मामनुयोक्ष्यते ॥

meaning.en: If he asks me, I shall tell the king: "I was once Yudhishthira's dear friend, dear as his own life."

verses.text:
इत्येतद्वो मयाख्यातं विहरिष्याम्यहं यथा ।
वृकोदर विराटे त्वं रंस्यसे केन कर्मणा ॥

meaning.en: That is what I have told you about how I shall pass the time. And you, Vrikodara, what work will you enjoy in Virata's house?
